artworks.title: Bronzes
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a lion lying on a ledge. Beside the lion, there are various ornate plates and vases arranged intricately. The color palette is monochrome, with black ink lines on a white background. The lion is positioned near the top left corner of the image, facing downward. The decorative items are clustered behind the lion to the right. On the left edge, there is an elaborate architectural column with a helmeted head sculpted into it.

artworks.title: Branch
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: In the image, there is a botanical drawing of a vertically oriented stem with leaves spreading outwards. The drawing is in black ink on an off-white background. The stem curves diagonally upwards to the right and inwards to the left, with the main features in the upper half of the image.

artworks.title: Casts from Antique Sculpture: The Parthenon
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The artwork features two sculptures depicted in a black and white drawing. The upper sculpture portrays a seated figure from the side with emphasis on muscular build and draped clothing against a detailed bas-relief showing multiple figures. The seated figure appears relaxed but attentive. Below, another sculpture is illustrated, featuring a standing male figure on a small pedestal in a contrapposto stance with muscular definition. The drawing emphasizes contrast and shadow, presenting the sculptures in a classical style.

artworks.title: Casts from Antique Sculpture: The Parthenon
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows intricate lines and shapes forming abstract representations of classical sculptures and figures. One seated figure is delicately shaded, resembling ancient Greek or Roman statuary. Another figure stands with well-defined shapes, reminiscent of a classical male statue. The background contains abstract, wavy lines suggesting movement and texture. These images draw connections to historical artifacts and artistic motifs of ancient mythology or bas-reliefs.

artworks.title: Index
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate blank label with decorative elements. The image shows a rectangular blank space with swirling ribbons and leafy or floral motifs. The design features intricate linework in black ink, creating a vintage or antique feel. The rectangle's edges are accentuated with zigzag-like extensions, and the overall composition has a harmonious balance. The background is plain, allowing the detailed drawing to stand out prominently.

artworks.title: Arch Rock, Kagosima Bay, Japan
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Edward M. East, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a natural arch rock formation standing prominently on the right side of the scene. The horizon is low in the image, with a small mountain or island and a ship visible beyond the arch in the open sea. Delicate brushstrokes and lines detail the rock and clouds, with shading defining textures. The color palette is muted with soft beige tones and lighter hues accentuating the clouds and waves. A small rowing boat is visible in the waters, adding scale and activity to the scene.

artworks.title: Sherberne Valley
artworks.medium: graphite and brown ink wash with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon line, clouds or sky visible above dense foliage. In the foreground, there is an open area with light vegetation depicted in sketchy lines. Moving back, a cluster of trees fills the central part of the image, with flowing lines indicating leaves and branches. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, varying in shading for depth and texture. The color palette is muted sepia tones, giving a vintage feel. In the distance, more trees are subtly represented with soft linework, enhancing the sense of depth through shades of gray.

artworks.title: Laisse-moi regarder encore ... papa!
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a monochromatic drawing depicting a group of individuals in a crowded setting. The scene shows attendees at what appears to be an art salon, wearing period attire with tall hats and formal clothing. The central figure, dressed in a checkered costume, is lifted above the crowd, potentially to view the displayed art or sculpture. The illustration conveys a sense of bustling activity and varied reactions to the artworks, with detailed expressions and postures showing interactions among the crowd.

artworks.title: Index
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental framed title with ribbons. The image features an intricately drawn rectangular frame positioned at the center, with decorative ribbons swirling around it. Above and below the frame, there are additional flourishes resembling vegetation or stylized leaves. The center of the frame contains text that appears to be a title, reading "BIOGRAPHICAL INDEX OF PAINTERS."

artworks.title: Palette
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white line drawing of a crab surrounded by intricate seaweed designs on light beige paper. The crab is positioned slightly left of center with its claws and seaweed extending towards the right. Light sketch marks and notes are present in the lower left and upper right corners of the page.

artworks.title: Study for "Sculpture"
artworks.medium: graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a sculpture on paper. The drawing depicts a reclining figure of an adult on cushions, with a small child or infant next to them. To the left stands an angelic figure with wings, looking downward. Another smaller angel is seated in the background. The drawing is monochrome, created with graphite on beige paper. The figures are on a rectangular base with the word "Sculpture" inscribed. The style is sketch-like, with shading for depth and texture. The overall composition appears naturalistic and serene.

artworks.title: Study for "Hell"
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a male figure in a kneeling position. The upper part of his body is shown, with his head resting on his forearm. His muscular arms are bent at the elbows, with one hand touching the ground. The face is partially turned towards the viewer. The hair is not detailed. The subject is nude, and the focus is on the muscular definition and contour of his body. There is no jewelry present. The background is a blank, neutral space that emphasizes the figure's form and the shadows created by the shading in the sketch.

artworks.title: Bateaux sur la Seine
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image displays a river scene with boats on the water, a bridge in the distance, and urban structures hinted at by sparse strokes. The illustration style features expressive cross-hatching in black ink on a sepia background, creating a vintage atmosphere.

artworks.title: Asher B. Durand
artworks.artist: Frederick Halpin, after Charles Loring Elliott
artworks.medium: engraving in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Samuel P. Avery, 1877)
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man from the chest up. He is slightly turned to his left, with his shoulders in view. His head is facing forward with a calm expression. He has piercing eyes, a long, full beard, and medium-length wavy hair. The man is dressed in a dark coat with no visible detailing, against a light background. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Papa, Carry Me—Take Me Up in Your Arms
artworks.medium: graphite, brush and black ink, and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. William J. Glackens, wife of the artist, 1943)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a group of people. In the center, there is an adult male and female, with the man wearing a tall top hat and a buttoned-up coat, and the woman wearing a bonnet and an elegant dress, holding a child. Other adults and children around them are also dressed in formal attire. Some figures appear in jovial poses, with activities like standing or chatting. The background shows an impressionistic natural setting with trees and leaves.

artworks.title: Coney Island Boardwalk
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Anna Meade Minnigerode, 1986)
artworks.description: The image depicts a beachside area filled with people enjoying a day out. The scene shows the ocean extending towards the left, with a steamship visible beyond a pier or dock. Structures with signage, such as "Otto Huburger" and "Photo Studio," can be seen, along with a "Virginia Peanuts" sign. People are seen moving about, sitting, and interacting. The brushwork is loose and sketchy, emphasizing movement and spontaneity, and the black and white color palette highlights lines and forms.

artworks.title: John Pento, 14 years old, Daniel and Angelo Pento, 7 years old, selling newspapers, Hartford, Connecticut
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Harry H. Lunn, Jr., through Graphics International Ltd., 1977)
artworks.description: Three boys are standing against a textured wall, with their full bodies visible. The boys are positioned side by side; the taller boy in the center stands slightly behind the two shorter boys, who are on either side of him. The boys have short hair peeking out from under their caps. They are wearing similar attire, including jackets, knee-length trousers, long socks, and sturdy boots. Each of the boys is holding newspapers under their arms. The boy in the middle wears a double-breasted coat with a pattern, while the others wear single-layered jackets. There is minimal jewelry visible. The background is a plain wall that appears to be part of a building, and the ground is covered with uneven stone slabs that have some dark stains. In the periphery, a partial view of other individuals can be seen, but the focus remains on the three boys.

artworks.title: Tony Casale, "Bologna," 11 years old been selling newspapers for 4 years, Hartford, Connecticut, March 1909
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Harry H. Lunn, Jr., through Graphics International Ltd., 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing upright and facing slightly to the right. His facial features include a determined expression with lips pressed together, and he has short, slightly tousled hair peeking out from underneath a cap. He is wearing a dark jacket and has a bundle of newspapers carried in a sling over his shoulder. The background is blurred, with the silhouette of a person in dark clothing walking and some indistinct buildings visible.

artworks.title: View Near the Falls of Schuylkill
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1955)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a landscape with a high horizon. The setting is a valley with steep sides, featuring hills and treetops in the distance. The composition uses detailed brushstrokes to depict the natural scenery. Earthy tones and muted greens dominate the color palette, with a soft, hazy light creating a serene atmosphere. In the foreground, there are rocky terrain, a figure in a red garment, and a white horse. A river winds through the background, surrounded by trees blending into the hills. The sky is depicted with soft grey, peach, and blue tones.

artworks.title: Richard Wagner and His Genius from Scenes of Rheingold
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in full-body view, with a third person partially visible in the background. One person is a woman standing in profile, facing to the right. Her head is slightly bowed, and her hair is styled in a bun under a headscarf or cap. She wears a long dress with long sleeves, holding a piece of fabric or a shawl. The second figure, possibly a woman, stands behind her in profile, wearing a similar dress and possibly a bonnet. To the right, there is a shadowy figure dressed in dark clothing in motion. The background features vertical striped patterns resembling columns or pillars.

artworks.title: The Bass Player (Le Jouer de Contre-Basse)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated, concentrating on placing a book on a surface in front of him while holding a cello under his left arm. He has a beard and mustache, dark wavy hair, and wears a striped shirt. The background includes a simple design resembling a bookshelf.

artworks.title: On the Hudson River
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a low horizon. A sailboat is in the water, with fine brushstrokes and intricate details on trees and rocks. In the distance, there are hills and cliffs. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and grey.

artworks.title: Study for "The Mountain Ford"
artworks.medium: graphite and white chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1952)
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with peaks visible in the distance. A tree with a large trunk is on the right side of the image. Delicate pencil strokes capture the details of the tree and mountains, with predominant shades of gray and earth tones. A figure on horseback can be seen crossing a path in the foreground.

artworks.title: Tree Near the Shore
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective with a large, gnarled tree on the left side. The tree has branches and leaves drawn in a light, sketchy style. Two small figures are on the right side, one standing and pointing, the other kneeling or sitting. The horizon is low in the drawing, indicating an open landscape beyond. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray on off-white paper.
